_meta.source: Wikidata: holders of each "Premier of …" position (P39) with dates and party (P102); English Wikipedia premiers' infoboxes for missing dates and terms
notes: Each term's family follows src/lib/party-families.ts. Gaps are periods with no premier on record: before responsible government in the territories, or brief changeovers.
Party override: Ujjal Dosanjh was premier as leader of the BC NDP; Wikidata lists only his later federal party.
Party override: Stuart Garson led Manitoba's Liberal-Progressive coalition government; Wikidata lists only the federal Liberals.
